items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: Him and Pick. I called Pick, that's what I called him.

ctx.x: And they had a little horse, blind horse. The horse was blind. And they had a little four-wheel wagon. And they used to go all along the riverfront, along that bugle. And you'd see long showmen, scroamers, and all kinds of different kinds of ways to buy the pies. See? So, when he winded up, the old man, his name was Pick. Pick, I don't know, down on the riverfront. He kept a saloon.
